// AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED: location from saved link.
Map.setCenter(264.8, 34.8, 4)

// --- 1. DEFINE YOUR POINTS ---
// If needed, replace with the actual path to your 'PRISM-points' asset.
var tableId = "projects/high-island-creek/assets/PRISM-points"; 
var stations = ee.FeatureCollection(tableId);

Map.centerObject(stations, 9);
Map.addLayer(stations, {color: 'red'}, '69 Weather Stations');

// --- 2. DEFINE DATES AND DATASET ---
var startDate = '1981-01-01';
var endDate = '2026-01-31'; 

// Load PRISM Daily 'ANd'.
var prism = ee.ImageCollection('OREGONSTATE/PRISM/ANd')
              .filterDate(startDate, endDate)
              .select(['ppt', 'tmax', 'tmin', 'tdmean']); // Add other variables as needed.

// --- 3. EXTRACT DATA FOR POINTS ---
var stationData = prism.map(function(image) {
  var stats = image.reduceRegions({
    collection: stations,
    reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), 
    scale: 4000, 
    crs: 'EPSG:4326'
  });

  // Keep original column information from the shapefile. Important for later on Colab.
  return stats.map(function(feature) {
    return feature.copyProperties(feature, feature.propertyNames())
      .set({
        'date_str': image.date().format('yyyyMMdd'),
        'year': image.date().get('year'),
        'doy': image.date().getRelative('day', 'year').add(1)
      });
  });
}).flatten();

// --- 4. FORMAT AND EXPORT TO DRIVE ---
var dailyDataWithCoords = stationData.map(function(f) {
  var coords = f.geometry().coordinates();
  return f.set({
    'longitude': coords.get(0),
    'latitude': coords.get(1)
  });
});

// IMPORTANT: Check if your shapefile has 'id' column or you might need to replace the name.
Export.table.toDrive({
  collection: dailyDataWithCoords,
  description: 'SWAT_PRISM_69_Stations_Master',
  fileFormat: 'CSV',
  selectors: ['id', 'date_str', 'year', 'doy', 'ppt', 'tmax', 'tmin', 'tdmean', 'longitude', 'latitude'] 
});
